📝 Notes
Feb 2, 2026
R&D daily sprint
Invited Amir Houieh Unbody io Noémi Biró Gabor Kerekes
Attachments R&D daily sprint Notes by Gemini 
Meeting records Transcript 
Summary
Noémi Biró initiated the meeting to discuss weekly goals, the cleanup of the Notion linear, and a request from Melissa for deliverables. Amir Houieh was assigned to export a raw data chat dump by Wednesday morning after coordinating access with Gabor Kerekes, while Gabor Kerekes is responsible for creating a list of "first category" metrics by Friday to share with Melissa for confirmation. Amir Houieh and Gabor Kerekes also clarified the distinction between the chat dump and metric analytics, agreeing that Gabor Kerekes's immediate task is to identify extractable data points, and Amir Houieh raised the need for focused content production for the lab and website in a scheduled meeting tomorrow.
Details
Weekly Goals and Deliverables Noémi Biró initiated the meeting to discuss weekly goals, the desired achievements, and a request from Melissa for deliverables. Noémi Biró also noted that they cleaned up the Notion linear, and the team can now use it to track their work (00:00:00).
Chat Dump Export Melissa requested a chat dump by Wednesday morning to analyze for team insights (00:00:00). Amir Houieh was assigned to export the chat dump after coordinating with Gabor Kerekes to ensure they have the necessary access and reliable tooling (00:04:05). Gabor Kerekes estimated the export process with redaction using Claude might take about 20 minutes once access is confirmed. The dump is to be exported as raw data in an MD file, zipped with a password, placed on Google Drive, and the password shared via Signal (00:05:09).
Low-Hanging Fruit Metrics and Data Delivery The team discussed identifying low-hanging fruits from the metric lists, with a particular interest in data related to how people use journaling for phase two insights (00:05:09). Gabor Kerekes agreed to focus on creating a list of these metrics by Friday (00:06:40). There was a discussion to clarify that the current focus is on the "first category" of metrics—those for which data can be quickly obtained with existing queries—and that the data should be available by Friday (00:08:02).
Distinction Between Chat Dump and Analytics Amir Houieh and Gabor Kerekes clarified that the chat dump and the metric analytics are two separate data sets (00:09:02). Gabor Kerekes emphasized the need to stick to precise, unambiguous queries for metrics, such as the number of messages sent in a journaling thread, rather than fuzzy metrics like requesting journaling through chat. Noémi Biró suggested that a metric on how many times journaling has been opened is possible and would provide insight into usage (00:11:07).
Scope of Metric Analysis Task The team agreed that Gabor Kerekes's immediate task is a "design task" to go through the metric list and determine what data is possible to extract, rather than immediately implementing the queries (00:13:33) (00:15:23). This list will be shared with Melissa for confirmation before the implementation stage, which Amir Houieh can also assist with (00:14:23). Gabor Kerekes plans to complete the design list today (00:15:23).
Friday Agenda and Actionable Items Noémi Biró outlined the Friday agenda, including a discussion of Dina and Civil's first draft of tired safety protocol ideas, a brainstorm on guided models, journaling, and a follow-up on moving forward with GitHub Pro for privacy (00:16:24).
Website Content and Lab Discussion Amir Houieh raised the need for content production for the lab and website, which they noted is minimal (00:16:24). A focused meeting to discuss the time frame for the next couple of weeks, the lab announcement, and who will write content was scheduled for tomorrow afternoon, after 2:20 PM (00:17:55).
Memory Tool and Invoice Amir Houieh mentioned having a memory tool ready to share today in a private repository with instructions, noting that it analyzes chat sessions but lacks persistent memory, as Claude stores everything locally (00:17:55). Amir Houieh also informed Gabor Kerekes that they will get back to them today regarding the invoice after meeting with Alex (00:19:25).
Suggested next steps
Gabor Kerekes will go through the metric list, identify the low-hanging fruits that are possible to deliver, and create a list today.
Amir Houieh will send a link for a focused discussion tomorrow afternoon with Gabor Kerekes and Noémi Biró to talk about the content production for the lab, the website, and side projects.
Amir Houieh will get back to the group today on the invoice after the meeting with Alex.
Amir Houieh will send a private repo with instructions for running the memory thingy.
Amir Houieh and Gabor Kerekes will work together to ensure Amir Houieh has reliable access to export the chat dump by Wednesday morning as an MD file, zip it with a password, put it on Google Drive, and share the password on Signal.
